statements.t: "Venture Global had an exceptional third quarter, with record sales and earnings, enabled by our team's best-in-class execution and LNG production at the high end of our anticipated range.

We are proud to have commenced commercial operations at Plaquemines Phase 1 on October 31 st and begun delivering on our long-term contracts at one of the fastest rates for a greenfield LNG project of this scale.

Our strong operational performance and outlook on pricing have allowed us to raise the midpoint of our volume and Consolidated Adjusted EBITDA guidance for FY 2026, and we remain confident in our business heading into next year," said Venture Global CEO Mike Sabel.
With cooler weather and completion of summer maintenance, we expect modestly higher fourth quarter production.
For 2027, we are planning incremental investments during the year which we expect should help enhance production volumes from the facility starting late next year.
Plaquemines: We commenced commercial operations at Phase 1 of the Plaquemines Project on October 31, 2026, and as of today have loaded six cargos for our SPA customers.
Subject to regulatory approvals, we are targeting FID in mid 2027 and first LNG in 2029.

CP2: Construction at our CP2 Project continues to advance well, and given the tremendous progress we have made since Phase 1 FID in July 2025, we are narrowing the timeline for first LNG production to mid-year 2027.
This should position the project to begin production approximately two years from FID, which we believe is substantially faster than any other LNG project of this scale to date.
We are also making progress on the 10 mtpa CP2 brownfield expansion and are targeting FID in early 2027 with first production in late 2028.
